hard_numeric_fact_text: FACT (company filings): order book Rs65,457 cr at 31 Mar 2026 vs FY26 revenue Rs27,143 cr (2.4x); Crisil upgraded long-term rating to AA+/Stable on 15 Oct 2026. MANAGEMENT CLAIM: FY27 YTD order inflow crossed Rs22,000 cr (21 Oct release, new orders Rs2,349 cr).

base.assumptions: ASSUMPTION: Order book (Rs65,457 cr at Mar-26, 2.4x FY26 revenue) converts at ~12% revenue growth, margin ~9%, 19x

bull.assumptions: ASSUMPTION: Revenue +18% CAGR, margin ~9.5-10%, Linjemontage value unlock, 22x

risk.balance_sheet: LOW: ND/EBITDA 0.77, interest cover 6.8, Crisil AA+
risk.order_firmness: MEDIUM: UAE gas pipeline LoA and L1 positions are not yet revenue; some inflow figures are management cumulative claims

thesis: Large T&D/B&F EPC with a Rs65,457 cr order book (2.4x revenue) and FY27 YTD inflows above Rs22,000 cr, now Crisil AA+/Stable and healthy FY CFO/PAT 1.48 at ND/EBITDA 0.77. Price is down ~7% since the 14 Oct review. But latest quarter revenue was -9.3% YoY, margin is thin (8.8%) and 13.7% of EBITDA is one-off, so orders have not yet shown up in reported growth. EV is positive but below the +30% starter bar; the missing link is order-to-revenue-to-EPS conversion.
chain_missing_links: Operating leverage (EBITDA margin 8.8%; one-offs 13.7% of EBITDA)
Execution period of order book: unknown
demand_signal: Grid expansion/renewable integration capex; management cites strong T&D inflows (MANAGEMENT CLAIM). Dossier peer set weak: median revenue -5.6%, only 4% growing >20%.
supply_signal: unknown; EPC is competitive, no shortage evidence
order_book: Rs65,457 cr at 31 Mar 2026 (company boilerplate, FACT/MANAGEMENT CLAIM); FY27 YTD inflow >Rs22,000 cr (MANAGEMENT CLAIM); 21 Oct release Rs2,349 cr; UAE gas pipeline LoA classed Major (>Rs4,000 cr, value not disclosed). Dossier 20 Oct event row (Rs20,000 cr, intensity 0.49) is a cumulative claim mislabelled as one order (conflict).
capacity_catalyst: none evidenced; Linjemontage (Sweden) listed 25 Sep 2026 at SEK46/share, KPIL retains ~65.9% and receives gross SEK ~711.5m (before expenses): balance-sheet/value event, not operating capacity (FACT).
debt: ND/EBITDA 0.77, interest cover 6.8; Crisil AA+/Stable upgrade 15 Oct 2026 (FACT)
valuation: Mcap Rs22,219 cr, TTM P/E 20.0, EV/EBITDA 10.3, PEG 0.57 (CALCULATION). Price Rs1,301, -10.8% from 52-wk high.

plausible.2x: NO: needs EPS ~Rs120 at 22x, i.e. ~Rs3,100 cr PAT with margin >10%

kill_conditions: Second consecutive quarter of YoY revenue decline despite order claims (Q2 FY27)
CFO/PAT below 0.7 or receivable days above 130
Material order cancellation or bank-guarantee/legal issue
biggest_risk: Order book fails to convert into revenue and margin; thin EPC margin plus working-capital stretch.
next_datapoint: Q2 FY27 results: revenue YoY (kill if negative again), EBITDA margin ex one-offs, H1 order book and CFO
